campus: ROME - Faculty of Architecture, Sapienza University of Rome, Palazzo Borghese (this is where the Joint Degree Course teaching center is located, per the official brochure: 'The Joint Degree Course teaching center is at the Faculty of Architecture of Sapienza University of Rome'). Partner department at UNITUS: DIBAF (Dipartimento per la Innovazione nei sistemi Biologici, Agro-alimentari e Forestali), Viterbo. Official 'Headquarter' field on the programme page reads: 'Faculty of Architecture, University "Sapienza" of Rome Palazzo Borghese Rome'. Official 'Department' field: 'Architecture and Design, Faculty of Architecture, University "Sapienza" of Rome, Rome & Innovation in Biological, Agro-Food and Forest Systems, Università della Tuscia, Viterbo'.
academic_requirements: Admission mechanism per the official programme page: 'Evaluation of the exams taken in the academic career and oral interview' - i.e. open access (no numero programmato, no TOLC), gated by (1) an academic-career/transcript evaluation and (2) a mandatory oral interview. No specific prior-degree classes, minimum CFU/ECTS thresholds by SSD, or GPA floor are published on any unitus.it page or PDF for this programme (the general-info/study-plan page for this course renders the WRONG content - an unrelated LM-2 archaeology/art-history curriculum with courses like 'Computer Science Applied to Cultural Heritage' and 'History of Medieval Art in Europe' - so it cannot be used as a source and must not be trusted). No unitus.it-hosted interuniversity convention document (analogous to the one found for the LM-77 Economics and Communication programme) could be located for this LM-3 programme despite searching; DIBAF's own regulations index page also lists no LM-3/Landscape Architecture regulation PDF. Foreign qualifications would be expected to require standard equivalency documentation (Dichiarazione di Valore / CIMEA Statement of Comparability) per the university-wide baseline, but this is not confirmed specifically for this programme on unitus.it. [uncertain]

entry_exam_or_test: No written entrance exam / no TOLC / no numero programmato. Admission is via (1) evaluation of exams already taken in the applicant's academic career (transcript/curriculum review) and (2) a mandatory oral interview, per the official programme page text: 'Admission: Evaluation of the exams taken in the academic career and oral interview'. The programme also appears as a selectable option ('ARCHITETTURA DEL PAESAGGIO (Laurea Magistrale LM-3)') in the university-wide Interview Booking form (https://www.unitus.it/en/join-unitus/how-to-enroll/interview-booking/). No further detail (interview format, language of interview, dates, scoring threshold, or what counts as a passing curriculum evaluation) is published on unitus.it for this specific programme.
